question: In which year was the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **2016** is the year when the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) was launched.
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana is a scheme aimed at incentivizing employers for the generation of new employment.
